name: Broad-shouldered jar
dimensions: H. 28.8 x W. (across handles) 31 x Diam. 27.2 cm (11 5/16 x 12 3/16 x 10 11/16 in.)
summary: Ovoid jar with cylindrical neck, broad shoulders, sides tapering inward to a small, flat base, and two strap lug handles positioned bilaterally below the shoulder; buff earthenware lightly burnished and decorated with geometric designs painted in black and burgundy slips before firing; painted designs on the shoulders include elliptical cartouches containing designs resembling three leaves, set against a crosshatched ground. Majiayao culture, Banshan type. From the upper Yellow River valley regi
